name: Hypertension Study (V4): Baseline Characterization (delay strata)
description: 5-group baseline comparison across diagnosis-delay strata (G1 timely <=3mo, G2 <=6mo, G3 <=12mo, G4 delayed >12mo, never-diagnosed) vs the full treatment-naive elevated-BP cohort. Supports OQ-13 (eGFR<60) and the under-diagnosis prevalence finding.
